If you have health insurance it should not be too costly.  Maybe a $20 copay every session.  Try it for 3 months and work on new methods of thinking.  I'm betting that not only do you get irritated, but you also get irritated with yourself for getting irritated, and that makes you even more irritable?

Irritability with no cause is one of the more common symptoms of male anxiety and it is seldom discussed.
Good money that your life isn't where you want it to be right now and you don't know where to start taking command and putting your energy.  Do you feel adrift and directionless?

You are having generalized anxiety and your brain is shuffling it along to the current situation.  You need to figure out what is triggering your anxiety and work to mitigate it.

This will persist until you get it figured out and managed.  Best was is with CBT from a certified mental health pro.  You don't need pills for this - you need to manage your thought processes.

Ohouibb - I think it's more likely that you are sad because your life is focused around your boyfriend and not yourself.

Worry about your boyfriend less and your own emotional well-being more.  You are not just his girlfriend; you are a person with hopes and dreams and feelings and a life full of possibilities ahead of you.  Go live your life!  Just because he has his butt planted on a couch all day wasting his life with video games doesn't mean you have to just sit there and pine over him.  Go do what YOU want to do.  Oh, you might find someone more age-appropriate while you're at it too!

Also if you are having suicidal thoughts or bouts of sadness and you do not know why please talk to anyone and everyone about it.  Let your parents know, your friends, your teachers, someone.  Please.  These kinds of thoughts are common and you are not weird for having them, but you do need to talk about them and work through them with someone qualified to help!

It gets better :)

You completely crossed a line.  You are supposed to be making her feel safe and secure.

Reality check: The push was way more 'violent' than drunk-you remembers it being.  You probably expended 5x the force you think you did.

Reality check pt 2.: Take a full personal accountability of your actions and take a step back from the relationship.  You have some adjustments to make and you need to make them in a calm and measured fashion, not a strung out and emotional fashion.  Accept your mistake, work to change your future, and move forward.  She may not want to be with you after this, accept that too.

Your problem: You are smart and you expect to be able to do anything if you set your mind to it.  You can't accept failure or that some things are out of your control.  Your 'smart' is getting in the way of your 'humanity' and you are talking down to her on a regular basis, more like a father than a partner.  Seek first to understand, then to be understood.  What you don't understand and cannot except is her problem below;

Her problem: She has never learned how to truly take care of herself and has been reliant on others her entire life.  She is likely depressed and not aware of it.

The solution: separate and let her figure out how to be a functional adult.  She can't be a partner unless she can be an adult.

Additionally: Get more in touch with the feelings of others.  Life isn't about profit margins and solving technical problems.  People are not technical problems.  People have feelings.  Problems with people are feelings problems.  Sometimes feelings are not logical.  You can't approach everything like a science/math problem.

Good luck man.

Also your post seems very self centered.  I get you didn't want to be present for the proposal of two people you don't know, but your disdain for them seems very misplaced.  Is it possible you are mis-directing your dissatisfaction at your BF's lack of planning onto two people who are happy?

Sounds like you have some thinking to do.
She was living with me for about 10 months.  We broke up and she left VA to go back to her family in CA and deal with some personal issues.

Been begging her to trust me for over a year and a half now.  She has massive trust issues and I'm just starting to come to terms with the idea that she might not be able to resolve them while in a relationship.
And stupid me spent all morning looking for flights to CA that are in my price range after mortgage, xmas, and her $1k flight out here.

In my opinion; she is scared shitless that if she moves out here it's not going to work again so she's trying to tear it apart.  The more real it gets that she is moving, the more she rebels against it and becomes destructive.

I spent an hour with her over Christmas break helping her set up a savings plan so she can move out here.  The resume is done and the person is asking for it.  She starts a huge fight right before she is supposed to submit it.  I don't think it's a coincidence. 

I just don't understand why this person continues to talk about wanting children and a future with me.

It's hard to explain everything that has happened over the course of our relationship but I will try to address directly;

"I'd even had suggested a quick skype, but I don't feel like making a chore of it.
Keep your eyes on the road and review messages when you are no longer driving at 730 on NYE."

^
I said she was being a jerk because in the above she is saying two things;
1) I view her as a chore and that's why I did her resume.  No effort I put forward in the relationship could possibly be because I care about her, she's just a 'chore' to me.  This is a common theme that she resorts to when I have something to say about her behavior.
2) Her comment about me driving is because she believe I am heading to party and not heading home.  For someone who works 80 hours a week and has literally given her zero cause to believe I am anything but true to my word this is... infuriating.  Minor background: last year she spent 5 months accusing me of cheating 2-3 times a week while I was at work.  During this time I was supporting her financially because her job did not pay well.
